suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: project uses params-object pattern for functions with many parameters (BuildIntegrateArtifactParams, BuildPlanArtifactParams, etc.) rather than positional arguments. Feature descriptions sometimes list positional parameters but actual implementations use object parameters.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: src/integrate/artifact.ts uses BuildIntegrateArtifactParams. Same pattern in src/plan/artifact.ts and src/execute/artifact.ts.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add boundary: when reusing functions from other modules, workers must verify that the reused function's I/O contract is compatible with the new use case — not just that it's importable. The original integrate-cli worker verified executeWorkstream was importable but didn't check if its response parsing format was compatible with the integrate flow.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: integrate-cli reuses executeWorkstream() which hard-codes ## CHANGES response parsing and file-writing, incompatible with the integrate flow's test-file generation format. Fix feature fix-integrate-cli-ai-call resolved this.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: CLI output formatter functions in src/cli.ts are duplicated across all 6 steps. Consider extracting a shared formatCommandOutput helper to reduce DRY violation. Each new step adds another nearly identical copy.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: src/cli.ts has 6 nearly identical formatXCommandOutput functions (lines 27-91).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update AI Integration section: remove 'Reuse executeWorkstream from src/execute/model-connector.ts — this is non-negotiable' and replace with correct guidance that integrate step uses loadModelConfig + callModel (not executeWorkstream). The current wording is misleading and could cause future workers to reintroduce the bug.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Mission AGENTS.md says 'Reuse executeWorkstream' but fix-integrate-cli-ai-call correctly replaced it with loadModelConfig + callModel. The library already documents this correctly in architecture.md and integrate-ai-call.md.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update backend-worker skill: remove 'DO NOT create a new AI model connector — reuse executeWorkstream from src/execute/model-connector.ts' and add nuanced guidance: 'For the execute step, reuse executeWorkstream; for the integrate step, use loadModelConfig + callModel directly (not executeWorkstream, which parses ## CHANGES format and applies file changes).'
